_comment: Camera sources priority list — sources tried from top to bottom. First live/valid source wins.

_instructions.type_ip_http: For DroidCam/IP webcam: set type=ip_http, url=http://IP:PORT/video
_instructions.type_rtsp: For CCTV/traffic camera RTSP: set type=rtsp, url=rtsp://user:pass@IP:PORT/stream
_instructions.type_webcam: For laptop/USB webcam: set type=webcam, index=0 (0=built-in, 1=external USB)
_instructions.type_video_file: For video file replay: set type=video_file, path=path/to/video.mp4
_instructions.enabled: Set false to skip a source without deleting it
